collections.title: Temples across India
collections.standfirst: Five routes that lead to temples, from Hampi and Thanjavur in the south to Konark and Khajuraho further north.
intro: These routes each end at, or pass through, a temple that is part of how the place is understood today. Some have ordered stops with a written story at each; others carry the route line and facts so far, with stories still to be written.
Pick the one nearest you, or treat the five as a way to compare how different regions built and used their temples.

collections.title: Royal heritage of the south
collections.standfirst: Hampi, Thanjavur, Mahabalipuram and Mysore: four places with a royal past, and the routes that walk through them.
intro: Hampi and Thanjavur have the fullest stories on Naarad so far, with ordered stops. Mysore and Mahabalipuram are listed with their route facts while their stops are written.

collections.title: Walks around Chennai
collections.standfirst: Eight recorded tracks across Chennai: the Marina, the lighthouse, Velachery, Thiruvanmiyur, IIT Madras and more.
intro: These are recorded tracks around the city, so they show where people have actually walked rather than a planned itinerary. Distances are listed where they were measured, and some are long: check the distance on each route before you set out.
Stops and stories for these routes are still being written.

collections.title: Cities of the north
collections.standfirst: Jaipur by bicycle, the lakes of Udaipur and the ghats of Varanasi at dawn.
intro: Three routes through northern cities, each suited to a different way of moving: cycling in Jaipur, a circuit in Udaipur, a walk at first light in Varanasi.

collections.title: Open-air routes
collections.standfirst: Coorg's plantations, the IIT Madras campus, a lake near the Chennai airport and Auroville.
intro: Four routes chosen for time outdoors: a plantation hike, a campus walk, a lake and a township.
